name: k-Truss Decomposition
problem_statement: Assign every edge the largest k for which it belongs to a maximal subgraph where each edge participates in at least k-2 triangles within that subgraph.

normalization: Reject directed input unless an explicit undirected projection is requested.
Collapse parallel edges into one undirected edge.

problem_inputs.name: requested_k
problem_inputs.description: Optionally materialize one k-truss in addition to the full decomposition.

required_outputs.name: truss_number_by_edge
required_outputs.description: Largest k-truss containing each normalized edge.

required_outputs.name: maximum_truss_number
required_outputs.description: Largest truss number assigned to any edge, or zero for an edgeless graph.

optional_outputs.name: requested_truss_edges
optional_outputs.description: Edges with truss number at least requested_k.

solution_semantics.objective: Compute the complete edge truss decomposition using the k-2 support convention.
solution_semantics.duplicate_policy: Each normalized edge has exactly one truss number.
solution_semantics.ordering: Edge removal order may vary while truss numbers remain invariant.

validation_rules: Every edge in a returned k-truss has support at least k-2 within that truss.
No edge belongs to a truss above its reported number.
Requested truss edges are exactly those with truss number at least requested_k.
edge_cases: Edges in no triangle have truss number two.
A triangle's three edges have truss number three.
An edgeless graph produces an empty map and maximum_truss_number zero.
